decoys.name: systematic-debugging
decoys.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, crash or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes: reproduce, isolate, find the root cause, then fix and verify.

decoys.name: web-performance
decoys.description: Diagnose slow web pages and slow network calls: large images and bundles, render-blocking resources, caching headers, request waterfalls, API latency, Core Web Vitals.

decoys.name: code-maintenance
decoys.description: Routine code changes: rename symbols, format files, upgrade dependencies, write unit tests, explain concepts, fix build and container errors, small UI features.

decoys.name: database-tuning
decoys.description: Speed up SQL queries and databases: read EXPLAIN plans, choose indexes, rewrite joins, tune Postgres and MySQL settings.

decoys.name: cloud-cost
decoys.description: Analyse and cut cloud bills and serverless costs: cost breakdowns, rightsizing, reserved capacity, cold starts, budgets.
